preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isalpha() or c.isspace() for c in word)
preconditions.description: The input string must contain only letters and spaces.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 0 if word == '' else stdout == sum(dict_scores.get(c.upper(), 0) for c in word if c.isalpha())
postconditions.description: The output must be the sum of the scrabble scores of the letters in the input string, ignoring spaces.
